description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) for alterations following planning permission 01045/B/P1 dated 30/03/2022 for the demolition of existing garages and erection of seven houses with associated access, cycle storage, landscaping and refuse and recycling storage.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from 30 March 2022, being the date of granting of planning permission 01045/B/P1.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (200580 1100, 200580 1500, 200580 1501 Revision 1, Archaeology Desk-Based Assessment & Heritage Statement, Cover Letter, Daylight and Sunlight Report, Design and Access Statement, Dusk Emergence Bat Survey, Groundsure Screening Report, Notice Letter, Preliminary Arboricultural Assessment, Preliminary Ecological Appraisal, Preliminary Bat Roost Assessment, Statement of Community Involvement and London Development Database  Management and Transport Statement. Received on 10 August 2021; 2020-3893-AT-107 (1) and SUDs Assessment Report. Received on 21 October 2021; Planning Statement. Received on 9 November 2021; Written Scheme of Investigation for Archaeological Evaluation. Received on 21 January 2022; Fire Safety Statement. Received on 10 March 2022; 200580 1150 Revision P01 and 2020-3893-AT-1101(1) Revision A. Received on 11 March 2022; 2313-PL-001, 2313-PL-002, Design Development Supporting Statement (dated June 2023) and Sustainability Statement (dated 10 May 2023). Received on 06/06/2023; 2313-PL-003-C, 2313-PL-004-A, 2313-PL-005-B, PBLX 3 240-360L (Bin Storage Housings), PBLX 4 240-360L (Bin Storage Housings) and PBLX4_LHH_SWD_GW_EU Revision 00. Received on 07/08/2023; 2313-PL-006-B and 2313-PL-007-B. Received on 20/09/2023) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the buildings are used.
Condition : 3 - The development shall not be implemented other than in accordance with the materials approved under 01045/B/P1(3).

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the details on the approved plans, prior to the occupation of the hereby approved development, details of hard and soft landscaping shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. 

Development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details and maintained in accordance with such thereafter. 

Any trees or plants that, within 5 years of planting, die, are cut down, uprooted, destroyed or become (in the opinion of the Local Planning Authority) seriously damaged or defective, shall be replaced with another tree or plant of the same size and species within the first planting season following its death, removal, uprooting or destruction, unless the Local Planning Authority gives its prior written approval to any variation.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 2015 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the hereby approved development or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.

Condition : 6 - The development hereby permitted shall be implemented in accordance with the approved Sustainability Statement and prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved:
a)	The applicant shall enter into a binding arrangement with the Council  to make an agreed contribution to the Council's Carbon Offset Fund, in accordance with the zero carbon strategy set out in the Sustainability Statement hereby approved to an amount that equates to the shortfall in required energy savings to meet the 'zero carbon' target.
b)	Evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the energy strategy in the approved Sustainability Statement and any subsequent approved revisions. 
c)	Upon final commencement of operation of any low and zero carbon technologies, performance data for energy consumption must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The performance data shall be submitted every 18 months to a monitoring web-platform for a period of three years from the point of full operation.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved plans, prior to first occupation of the hereby approved development, details of the roof solar panels and a detailed roof layout demonstrating that the roof's potential for solar photovoltaic installation has been maximised shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and thereafter implemented as approved and brought into operation before first occupation.
Condition : 8 - Prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved, the development shall have been constructed to achieve an internal water use of 105 litres/person/day or less.

Condition : 9 - The development hereby approved shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of delivery notes, invoices or installation contracts) have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development meets the following: 

 	At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) are to achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) The Green Guide of specification. 

 	At least 50% of timber and timber products are to be sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme. 

 	No construction or insulation materials are to be used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.

Condition : 10 - The first floor windows formed in the front elevation, which serve bathrooms and the first floor side facing window (in the first dwelling) of the hereby approved development as shown on approved drawing number 2313-PL-006-B shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 11 - Prior to the occupation of the hereby approved development, all landscaping comprised in the approved details shall be carried and the boundary treatment as shown in the drawings numbered 2313-PL-003-C, 2313-PL-004-A and 2313-PL-005-B shall be erected in strict accordance with the approved plans.
Condition : 12 - The development shall take place in accordance with the details contained within the approved Constructions Logistics Plan under 01045/B/P1(12).

Condition : 13 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 14 - Secure covered cycle parking facilities (for not less than 14 bicycles) for the occupants of the development shall be installed in the rear gardens and two Sheffield stands for visitors beside the communal area. 

The approved facilities shall conform to the current Westtrans West London Cycle Parking Guidance (or such other guidance as shall supersede it) in design and layout and be fully implemented and made available for use before the first occupation of the development or commencement of the approved use as appropriate and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 15 - Prior to first occupation of the hereby approved development a waste management strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show how waste will be managed on site specifically on waste collection days. 

Waste management shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 16 - The development shall take place in accordance with the details contained within the approved Written Scheme of Investigation (WSI) under 01045/B/P1(16,18).

The development shall not be occupied until the site investigation and post investigation assessment has been completed in accordance with the programme set out in the approved Written Scheme of Investigation (WSI) and the provision for analysis, publication and dissemination of the results and archive deposition has been secured.

Condition : 17 - Following approval of details under 01045/B/P1(17) and before the development is first brought into use: 

If additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development, the agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clause c), shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report referred to in clause d), shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.
Condition : 18 - The drainage system and associated drainage features approved under 01045/B/P1(16,18) shall be carried out in strict compliance with the approved details.

Condition : 19 - No part of the development hereby approved shall be occupied until evidence (photographs and copies of installation contracts, along with a written confirmation) has been submitted to the local planning authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the sustainable drainage scheme hereby approved has been completed in accordance with the submitted final detailed drainage designs. The sustainable drainage scheme shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the agreed management and maintenance plan for all of the proposed drainage components.

Condition : 20 - The hereby approved development must be carried out in accordance with the recommendations approved Dusk Emergence Bat Survey and Preliminary Ecological Appraisal received on 10 August 2021.

Condition : 21 - In this condition 'retained tree' means any existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, and paragraphs (a) and (b) below shall have effect until the expiration of five years from the date of the occupation of any of the buildings hereby approved.  

(a) No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority. Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard 3998 (Tree Work) or any other BS replacing this. Appropriate measures shall be taken in accordance with industry best practice to protect the retained trees for the duration of the works on site. 

(b) If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 22 - Prior to occupation, the development shall achieve 'Secured by Design' accreditation awarded by the Design-Out Crime Officer from the Metropolitan Police Service on behalf of the Association of Chief Police Officers (ACPO).

No dwelling shall be occupied until accreditation has been achieved and evidence of such accreditation has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority.
